llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed integration guide for using CellCog as a remote AI sub-agent, with clear file-sharing warnings and no hidden code in the artifact.

dimensions.detail: Requiring python3, a CELLCOG_API_KEY, and network access to CellCog is proportionate for a hosted AI sub-agent integration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md and only documents installing the official Python SDK with pip if needed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions generally require user-directed prompts and explicit SHOW_FILE or GENERATE_FILE tags; the blanket advice to print full result messages can expose returned paths or content in logs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The SDK may use notify-mode background delivery, WebSocket monitoring, and default downloads under ~/.cellcog/chats, all described in the artifact and aligned with long-running task delivery.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill enables broad remote AI tasks, including uploading explicitly tagged local files and generating downloaded artifacts, which is high-capability but coherent with its stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending explicitly tagged files and prompts to CellCog. Do not wrap secrets, private keys, .env files, or other sensitive material in SHOW_FILE tags, and be careful printing full result messages in shared or logged environments.
llm.findings: [SSD-3] expected: The finding is supported by the artifact's instruction to print the entire result message; this is expected for returning generated file paths and completion details, but users should avoid exposing sensitive outputs in shared logs.
